subject: Risk & Control Mapping workshop — scheduling and Q&A digest
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@sentinellabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Risk & Control Mapping workshop — proposed times and agenda

Hi Tom —

Thanks for taking the first step on the SIG/SOC2 intake. To make the questionnaire pass faster on our side, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute Risk & Control Mapping (RCM) workshop where we: 
- walk through the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire scope you care most about (auth, data flows, telemetry)
- map controls to evidence artifacts and owners
- confirm log sampling and retention expectations for SOC 2

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Nov 16, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Nov 17, 08:30–09:45
- Thu Nov 18, 14:00–15:15

Attached: RCM_Workshop_Agenda_v1.pdf and a short prework-question-bundle.docx (3 asks we need answered in advance). If none of the above times work, share a couple of windows and we'll adapt.

Agenda highlights (attached):
1) Intake + scoping decisions (data residency, subprocessor list)
2) Walk SIG control families and CAIQ mapping
3) Evidence handoff runbook (where to upload logs, naming conventions)
4) Action register and owners + expected delivery dates

Internal note: Marissa, Ben — please confirm availability. Ben for telemetry/log sampling; Marissa for CAIQ owner.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: RCM_Workshop_Agenda_v1.pdf (1 page), prework-question-bundle.docx (1 page)

From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@sentinellabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@sentinellabs.com
Date: 2026-11-10T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Risk & Control Mapping workshop — proposed times and agenda

Hi Neha —

Thanks — all of that sounds good. We can do Wed Nov 17 at 08:30 PST (our 11:30 EST). Attendees on our side: me (Tom, security lead), Priya Shah (cloud infra), and an external auditor, audit@sentinellabs.com (they're joining to confirm SOC 2 sampling approach).

Two asks from us before the call: 
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will demonstrate historic log retention settings or only provide exports? We want to scope the SOC2 sampling window.
2) We'll upload our CAIQ export and SIG draft to a share link during the day — is that fine?

If you prefer a 75 min slot so we don't rush telemetry, we can keep the 75-min buffer.

Best,
Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Head of Security, Sentinellabs

Thanks Tom — Wed Nov 17 08:30 PST works for our squad. I've confirmed Ben will join for the telemetry/loging discussion and I will lead the CAIQ walkthrough. Neha, I'm adding two internal bullets to the agenda: 
- evidence naming convention (we use folder: account-id/year/control-id)
- pointer to secure upload (we will use the shared Drive folder in the related links)

Tom, re: your asks: 
1) Retention: we can demonstrate current retention settings in the console and export historic samples for the sampling window. We'll plan to show both so the auditor has visibility.
2) CAIQ: yes please upload the CAIQ export (json or spreadsheet) into the Drive folder and drop a short readme with which controls you think are partial. That will speed mapping.

I'm attaching a short prework checklist (prework-question-bundle.docx) — please fill the three quick fields so we can prioritize controls.

Action owners (pre-call):
- Tom: upload CAIQ export + list of partial controls (by EOD Mon Nov 15)
- Priya (your infra lead): short network diagram (png) in Drive (by Mon 15)
- Neha: prep evidence runbook and invite calendar

Marissa Cole
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: RCM workshop — notes, runbook link, and action register (post-call)

Hi all —

Thanks for a productive session this morning. Short summary and agreed actions below. Notes are high-level; I captured the runbook and evidence mapping in the Drive folder (link below).

Summary highlights:
- Scope: SIG v2 + CAIQ mapping for controls in Auth, Logging/Telemetry, Data Residency, and Change Management
- Evidence portal: Redwood will provide console screenshots for retention settings + a zipped sample export for the 90-day window
- Auditor wants both live retention demo + exported logs (to validate sampling)

Action register (owner — due):
1) Tom: upload final network diagram and identify any partial controls in CAIQ (by 2026-11-15)
2) Ben Carter (Redwood): create log export for 90-day sampling window and place zip in Drive (by 2026-11-18)
3) Marissa Cole (Redwood): publish evidence checklist with expected file paths and naming conventions into Drive (by 2026-11-15)
4) Neha Kapoor (Redwood): assemble final RCM deliverable (mapping table + link to artifacts) and route to audit@sentinellabs.com (by 2026-11-19)
5) Sentinellabs auditor (audit@sentinellabs.com): confirm sampling targets for SOC2 testing (by 2026-11-20)

Drive runbook + artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bRCM_Workshop
DocuSign (permissions request form): https://app.docusign.com/documents/73a2e9

Attachments added to the folder: evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx (stub), RCM_mapping_table-draft.csv (stub)

If anyone sees an ownership or deadline mismatch, flag it here — otherwise I'll mark these as the working plan and follow up with a brief deliverable email.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference
